search_scope.queries: symbolic regression, equation discovery, amortized symbolic regression, neural symbolic regression; bounded web and publisher pages; older baselines included
search_scope.limitations: HF connector model_search and complete Hub tree API unavailable; no sufficiently verified 7-day weight release found; 30-day card activity not treated as exact dates; October papers within 90 days; not exhaustive

rasr.training: ~62M synthetic datasets, TabICLv2 prior, risk-sensitive GRPO; S complexity penalty 0.5, M 0.15, L 0.05
rasr.architecture: Alternating row/feature attention encoder, prefix expression decoder
rasr.positive: Author S reports mean expression size 10.3 nodes, mean 26s on 12 SRBench 2.0 black-box tasks; family strong average test R2 rank; no independent verification.
rasr.negative: S may sacrifice fit vs L; up to 11 finite features, no missing values, restricted operator vocabulary, Feynman recovery not universally superior; hardware/clock/batch unverified; no guarantee of unique physical law.
rasr.license: MIT card; MIT source LICENSE; no user act-rights decision
rasr.source_access_change: No verified change observed; public card/pointer only
rasr.runtime: Python >=3.12,<3.14; torch >=2.6; simplipy==0.2.14; torchtitan gitlink; triton, NumPy, scipy, scikit-learn. Local safetensors/config supported; snapshot_download if nonlocal path, SimpliPyEngine.load(..., install=True) in estimator/worker; offline engine/wheelhouse not audited.
